about: PROPOSAL from the story director (stage 4) for level-design owned fields: levels.js story (+ text[].story), optional startLine, and chapters.json intro/tagline. Level design merges; this file is not read at runtime. Checked by design/story/tools/check-story.mjs (errors). 'intro' marks a stage that introduces a mechanic: its story line is the hint said in world words (narrative-structure 4.0-3). alt = a scene line (intro stages, and stages whose story nearly repeats the current hint) that does not repeat the hint, for any screen that shows the story line and the hint together (blind QA 1 observation, 2026-11-11). startLine is only set where the story director suggests 'hint' (button names matter); empty = default 'story'.

stages.en: Count from one. The seventh step opens.

alt.en: Home's ground answers steps slowly now.

stages.en: We give our steps. The door opens.

stages.story: 길은 많아도 일곱 걸음 길은 하나.
stages.en: Many roads. Only one is seven steps.

alt.en: At every fork, the three count again.

stages.story: 옛 발판은 머무는 이에게 문을 연다.
stages.en: Old plates open doors for whoever stays.

alt.en: The first goodbye. Back when stars align.

stages.en: Each plate keeps its own door.
The stone that holds also blocks.

alt.en: The first stone keeps watch at home.

stages.en: Past the last door, the road begins.

stages.story: 그 자리에서 지도를 건넬 수도 있다.
stages.en: Or hand the map over, right there.

alt.en: One can help without staying.

stages.en: Too far for one. Not for three.
Sunken ground bridges on the seventh step.

alt.en: Stars drift below the holes.

stages.en: To be a bridge, or a stone?
Across the hole, the next one wakes.
The stars below grow deeper.
Past the starhole, the next star shines.
Gates open only on their carved step.

alt.en: The watchers' hands live on the pillars.

stages.en: Beyond the carving, a place to hold.

stages.story: 두 문의 새김을 한 셈에 맞춘다.
stages.en: One count must fit both carved gates.
Some gates ask for the second step.
Steps over a bridge count too.

alt.en: The carvings run on across the holes.

stages.en: The handover spot sets the next count.
Old stones, as tall as the three.
On ice, a full slide counts once.

alt.en: A cold moon. Feet won't stay put.

stages.en: The floor alone won't make seven.

alt.en: The ice shakes the count.

stages.en: The carvings count slides too.
No wall? A standing stone stops you.

alt.en: The three steady each other on ice.

stages.story: 멈춰 준 돌이 다음 길을 막는다.
stages.en: The stone that stops may also block.

alt.story: 기대 선 형제 곁으로 얼음이 흐른다.
alt.en: Ice flows past a brother leaning still.

stages.en: If the slide ends at a hole…
Past the ice, the home star shows.
On the seventh, the lever flips walls.

alt.en: Timber and brass wait, holding still.

stages.story: 내려간 벽은 레버 한 번에 솟는다.
stages.en: A lowered wall rises at one pull.

alt.en: Not every door can stand open.

stages.en: A risen wall can stop a slide.

alt.en: The sunken walls are waiting.

stages.en: A handle turns once. A plate holds.

alt.en: Cold brass, warm timber.

stages.en: Move the walls, and the count shifts.
Brass handles at the three's hand height.

stages.story: 마지막 톱니가 금 간 별을 가리킨다.
stages.en: The last gear points at cracked ground.

stages.story: 금 간 바닥은 한 번만 버틴다.
stages.en: Cracked floor holds only once.

alt.en: Cracks spread from every footprint.

stages.en: Choose which road falls and which stays.

stages.story: 옛 문은 서 있는 선돌을 센다.
stages.en: The old gate counts standing stones.

alt.en: The old gate is counting something.

stages.en: Even blind alleys have their use.
This gate opens while no stone stands.

alt.story: 이 문은 텅 빈 원을 품고 있다.
alt.en: This gate bears an empty ring.

stages.story: 굳은 바닥은 길일 뿐, 돌이 아니다.
stages.en: Sealed floor is road, not stone.

alt.en: Traces come in many shapes.

stages.en: No way back. Only counting forward.

stages.story: 물이 모인 늪, 진흙은 두 걸음.
stages.en: In the bog, mud costs two steps.

alt.en: Bog mud grabs at their feet.

stages.en: Mud skips a number in the count.

alt.en: The bog counts every step heavy.

stages.en: Ice runs fast. Mud weighs heavy.

alt.en: Between swift ice and heavy bog.

stages.story: 배운 셈을 이 방에서 다 쓴다.
stages.en: Every count they learned, in one room.

stages.story: 닫힌 문 하나가 길의 전부는 아니다.
stages.en: A shut gate isn't the only way.

stages.story: 남은 돌도 놓인 다리도 우리 길이다.
stages.en: Our stones and bridges became the road.

stages.story: 자루 끝 별이 깬다. 원이 가깝다.
stages.en: The last star stirs. The circle nears.

alt.en: The circle in sight. One last room.

stages.story: 오늘 밤 일곱째 걸음이 별을 잇는다.
stages.en: Tonight a seventh step joins the stars.

en.intro: Without stars, no step will count.
Find the count that crosses holes.
en.tagline: A moon of holes and stars

en.intro: The circle's count is carved here.
Close the bowl before going onward.
Only the old gears open the rest.
The last foothold before the circle.

chapters.intro: 한 밤 안에 원을 맞춰야 한다.

en.intro: The circle must align this one night.
